recap.text: Jacobus is a level ninety Reverse Tooth Fairy who is tiny, blond, and absurdly muscled with wings that move too fast to see. A patch on the Scavenger’s Daughter made him a permanent totem card, which nobody intended. Imani has him now, and the paperwork to reverse it does not exist.

beats.headline: The card that never went away
beats.text: Subject is a Reverse Tooth Fairy, level ninety, and he was a totem card until a patch on the Scavenger’s Daughter made him permanent, which nobody intended. He is tiny, absurdly muscled, blond, and his wings move too fast to see. Imani has him now. The paperwork to reverse it does not exist.
beats.gist: Jacobus is a level ninety Reverse Tooth Fairy and permanent totem card held by Imani.
